Knowledge recorded by Shinnecock elders in 2014

Cattle and colonial change

The catalogue remembers introduced cattle as disruptive to Shinnecock dwellings, followed by adaptation to their use on farms. The account connects livestock with colonial change and later farm work.1

Places named in the catalogue

South Shore farms.1

Page references

The Shinnecock Environmental Department compiled this catalogue from elders’ memories and community resource knowledge in 2014. Food and medicine appear here as historical knowledge; safe identification and treatment require current guidance.

Shinnecock Environmental Department, Natural Resources Identified by Shinnecock Elders, April 4, 2014, PDF p. 12. Page numbers count the cover as PDF page 1.
